description: CatBoost on the exp009 feature set. CatBoost handles categorical features natively (geology labels) and often produces predictions that are decorrelated from LightGBM/XGBoost, making it valuable for stacking. exp009 LGBM=34.58, exp012 XGB=34.60; CatBoost is the third diverse model.
implementation_notes: Use the EXACT exp009 feature matrix. Pass the geology label columns as cat_features (native CatBoost categorical handling — drop the fold-safe target-encoded version of the same column to avoid double-counting).
CatBoost params: task_type='GPU' (CUDA), iterations=6000, learning_rate=0.05, depth=8, l2_leaf_reg=5.0, random_seed=42, od_type='Iter', od_wait=200, eval_metric='RMSE'.
5-fold GroupKFold by well_id. Save OOF and test predictions in original CSV row order.
Target: be competitive (within 0.5 RMSE of exp009). Stacking diversity matters more than absolute score here.
